description: What the unattended weekly sync may do on its own. autosync/* branches cannot change this file (scripts/check-qc-ratchet.mjs); edit it yourself to widen or narrow autonomy.

backend.reason: Backend changes go to the shared production ERP (web + mobile, whole company) and this cloud environment cannot reach production to verify them. Flip autoMerge/autoDeploy to true to let the loop merge its own green PrizmIT/prizm331 PRs and run 'Deploy On Demand'.
